design_contract: Harvestwood stays agricultural and inhabited as it becomes uncanny; pumpkin imagery is not synonymous with hostility.
Sir Pumpkinhead is the protected Wildlands anchor and Lord Pumpkinhead is the protected Dread final. Neither is a routine quest target.
Tunnel Gore is intentionally absent from this catalog because its bespoke underground encounter needs dedicated runtime/location semantics.
runtime_assumptions: Only existing quest primitives are used: structure survey, structure recovery, and structure hostile clear.
Every structure target is an exact registry ID already present in the current registry/structure audit.

Definitions use sameMacroRegion=true through the existing catalog helpers; there is no explicit issuing-region field in Definition, so region specificity still depends on the selected generated target being in the issuing village's macro-region.
Quest list order gives a best-effort authored cadence inside a profession/tier, but hard prerequisites are not encoded by the current Definition schema.
No semantic Quality Equipment floor/reroll API is assumed; executable rewards use already-established exact item/enchantment IDs or vanilla items.

knowledge_rewards.knowledge: A scarecrow built from dark oak, hay, and a carved pumpkin can be awakened with an Ethereal Spirit into a Pumpkin Spirit.
knowledge_rewards.implementation: Post-completion dialogue only; no recipe interception or entity spawning is added.

knowledge_rewards.knowledge: Fire transforms a Pumpkin Spirit into a hostile Seared Spirit; a Transmuting Elixir can transform Seared into Infernal Spirit.
knowledge_rewards.implementation: Knowledge reward only. The quest does not give a Transmuting Elixir.

knowledge_rewards.knowledge: Transmuting Elixir can also convert iron blocks into Dark Metal, tying deep Harvestwood investigation to the occult material economy.
knowledge_rewards.implementation: Knowledge reward only; no repeatable high-value transmutation reagent is granted.

gated_future: Direct conversation/relationship content for the verified Born in Chaos farm resident requires a HabitationContext path because the current village conversation quest manager intentionally operates on VillageContext.
A formal Sir Pumpkinhead commission should be added only after exact encounter/kill-credit binding is authoritative; evidence and preparation quests are executable now.
Fel Lamp/Felsteed knowledge belongs after Sir Pumpkinhead or another progression-appropriate discovery, not in early repeatable content.
Lord Pumpkinhead remains a one-time Dread final after readiness and final-route prerequisites; the current final encounter binding is not authoritative enough to make executable here.
True entity observation/photography objectives need a dedicated objective primitive; current ecology content therefore uses structure observation/evidence rather than fake kill counters.
Hard authored chain prerequisites and an explicit issuer macro-region field would require shared runtime/schema work and are deliberately not added on this regional branch.
Semantic positive/strong-positive Quality Equipment rewards and reforge services remain gated until the live Quality API/config contract is frozen.
